#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Refined render — LLMs in Medicine academic poster
A0 portrait @ 150 dpi  →  4967 × 7020 px
"""
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os, math

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
OUT_PATH  = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
DPI       = 150
W, H      = 4967, 7020

# ── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = (10,  23,  48)
WHITE      = (255, 255, 255)
TEAL       = (58, 148, 168)
TEAL_LT    = (120, 195, 215)
TEAL_DK    = (35,  90, 110)
TEAL_PALE  = (180, 225, 235)
AMBER      = (225, 148,  50)
AMBER_PALE = (248, 210, 155)
GRAY_RULE  = (38,  60,  92)
CARD_BG    = (16,  36,  64)
CARD_RISK  = (32,  18,  10)
BODY       = (205, 220, 238)
MUTED      = (118, 148, 178)
SOFT_BG    = (14,  30,  58)
HDR_BG     = (6,   16,  34)

def F(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

def build_fonts():
    return dict(
        H1     = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf",    300),
        H1b    = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf",    240),
        H2     = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf",    120),
        H2b    = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf",     96),
        H3     = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf",     78),
        MET_XL = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf",        260),
        MET_L  = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf",        200),
        MET_M  = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf",        140),
        SB     = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",   82),
        SR     = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",72),
        SS     = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",58),
        SXS    = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",50),
        SeB    = F("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf",     75),
        SeR    = F("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf",  70),
        SeS    = F("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf",  57),
        SeI    = F("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf",   62),
        MB     = F("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf",      58),
        MR     = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   50),
    )

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def hline(d, y, x0=0, x1=W, color=GRAY_RULE, width=4):
    d.line([(x0,y),(x1,y)], fill=color, width=width)

def rr(d, x0,y0,x1,y1, r, fill, outline=None, ow=0):
    d.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y1], radius=r,
                         fill=fill, outline=outline, width=ow)

def tw(d, txt, font, x, y, col, max_w, ls=1.42):
    """Word-wrap; returns y after last baseline."""
    words = txt.split()
    lines, cur = [], []
    for w in words:
        probe = " ".join(cur+[w])
        if d.textlength(probe, font=font) <= max_w:
            cur.append(w)
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
            cur = [w]
    if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
    bb = d.textbbox((0,0),"Hg",font=font)
    lh = (bb[3]-bb[1]) * ls
    for ln in lines:
        d.text((x,y), ln, font=font, fill=col, anchor="lm")
        y += lh
    return y

def sec_head(d, fonts, x, y, n, title, w, col=TEAL):
    R = 48
    # circle badge
    d.ellipse([x, y-R, x+R*2, y+R], fill=col)
    d.text((x+R, y), n, font=fonts["MB"], fill=NAVY, anchor="mm")
    d.text((x+R*2+40, y), title.upper(), font=fonts["H2b"], fill=WHITE, anchor="lm")
    hline(d, y+R+20, x0=x, x1=x+w, color=col, width=5)

def metric_card(d, fonts, x0,y0,x1,y1, val, lbl, ctx, accent, risk=False):
    bg = CARD_RISK if risk else CARD_BG
    rr(d, x0,y0,x1,y1, 24, bg, outline=accent, ow=6)
    bar = 16
    d.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y0+bar+24], radius=24, fill=accent)
    d.rectangle([x0,y0+24,x1,y0+bar+24], fill=accent)
    cx = (x0+x1)//2
    h = y1-y0
    vf = fonts["MET_L"] if len(val)>5 else fonts["MET_XL"]
    d.text((cx, y0+h*0.37), val, font=vf,
           fill=AMBER if risk else WHITE, anchor="mm")
    d.text((cx, y0+h*0.62), lbl, font=fonts["SB"], fill=accent, anchor="mm")
    tw(d, ctx, fonts["SeS"], x0+46, y0+h*0.80, MUTED, x1-x0-90, 1.30)

def app_card(d, fonts, x0,y0,x1, title, desc):
    h = 185
    rr(d, x0,y0,x1,y0+h, 14, (18,38,70), TEAL_DK, 3)
    d.text((x0+30, y0+54), title, font=fonts["SB"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    tw(d, desc, fonts["SeS"], x0+30, y0+128, MUTED, x1-x0-60, 1.30)
    return y0+h+20

def risk_item(d, fonts, x0, y, w, title, desc, accent=AMBER):
    d.rectangle([x0, y, x0+10, y+200], fill=accent)
    d.text((x0+38, y+50), title, font=fonts["SB"], fill=accent, anchor="lm")
    y2 = tw(d, desc, fonts["SeS"], x0+38, y+118, BODY, w-52, 1.35)
    return max(y2, y+200) + 22

def fw_card(d, fonts, x0,y0,x1, n, title, desc, accent):
    rr(d, x0,y0,x1,y0+260, 18, CARD_BG, outline=accent, ow=5)
    d.text((x0+44, y0+68), n, font=fonts["MB"], fill=accent, anchor="lm")
    d.text((x0+115, y0+68), title.upper(), font=fonts["SB"], fill=WHITE, anchor="lm")
    tw(d, desc, fonts["SeS"], x0+44, y0+150, MUTED, x1-x0-80, 1.35)
    return y0+280


# ── Render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def render():
    img  = Image.new("RGB", (W,H), NAVY)
    d    = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    fnt  = build_fonts()

    MAR     = 185
    GAP     = 88
    col3w   = (W - 2*MAR - 2*GAP) // 3
    C1, C2, C3 = MAR, MAR+col3w+GAP, MAR+2*(col3w+GAP)

    # ── Background diagonal texture ──────────────────────────────────────────
    for i in range(-H, W+H, 130):
        d.line([(i,0),(i+H,H)], fill=(13,27,52), width=2)

    # ── Top decorative stripe ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    d.rectangle([0,0,W,20], fill=TEAL)

    # ── Header ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    HDR_H = 620
    d.rectangle([0, 20, W, HDR_H], fill=HDR_BG)
    # conference bar
    d.rectangle([0, 20, W, 110], fill=(8, 20, 42))
    d.text((MAR, 64), "MEDICAL AI & DIGITAL HEALTH CONFERENCE 2024",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=TEAL, anchor="lm")
    d.text((W-MAR, 64), "ACADEMIC POSTER  ·  PEER-REVIEWED REVIEW",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=MUTED, anchor="rm")

    # Title
    d.text((MAR, 215), "LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS",
           font=fnt["H1"], fill=WHITE, anchor="lm")
    d.text((MAR, 430), "IN MEDICINE",
           font=fnt["H1"], fill=TEAL, anchor="lm")
    d.text((MAR, 542),
           "Opportunities, Risks, and the Path Forward  \u00b7  "
           "A Comprehensive Review  \u00b7  Nature Medicine, July 2023",
           font=fnt["SeI"], fill=MUTED, anchor="lm")

    # right accent bar
    d.rectangle([W-28, 0, W, HDR_H], fill=TEAL_DK)
    hline(d, HDR_H, color=TEAL, width=9)

    # ── Metric cards ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    MET_Y  = HDR_H + 72
    MET_H  = 460
    cardw  = (W - 2*MAR - 3*GAP) // 4

    metrics = [
        (">90%",      "GPT-4 USMLE Score",
         "Exceeded all 3 USMLE steps — well above the ~60% passing threshold",
         TEAL, False),
        ("500+",      "PubMed Articles (2023)",
         "Peer-reviewed LLM-in-medicine publications in a single calendar year",
         TEAL_LT, False),
        ("Up to 30%", "Hallucination Rate",
         "LLMs fabricate plausible but incorrect medical information in up to 30% of outputs",
         AMBER, True),
        ("$10.5B",    "Healthcare LLM Market 2030",
         "Projected global market for healthcare LLM applications",
         TEAL, False),
    ]
    for i,(val,lbl,ctx,acc,risk) in enumerate(metrics):
        x0 = MAR + i*(cardw+GAP)
        metric_card(d, fnt, x0, MET_Y, x0+cardw, MET_Y+MET_H,
                    val, lbl, ctx, acc, risk)

    hline(d, MET_Y+MET_H+78, color=GRAY_RULE, width=4)

    # ── Body top ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    BODY_Y = MET_Y + MET_H + 118

    # === COLUMN 1 — Overview + Applications ===================================
    y1 = BODY_Y
    sec_head(d, fnt, C1, y1+50, "01", "Overview", col3w, TEAL)
    y1 += 158

    y1 = tw(d,
        "Large language models (LLMs) — GPT-4, Med-PaLM 2, and LLaMA — are "
        "transformer-based foundation models trained on vast text corpora. "
        "They have entered healthcare with extraordinary velocity, demonstrating "
        "capabilities in medical knowledge retrieval and clinical reasoning "
        "unimaginable just three years ago.",
        fnt["SeR"], C1, y1, BODY, col3w, 1.45) + 52

    # pull quote
    rr(d, C1, y1, C1+col3w, y1+218, 16, (14,28,58), TEAL_DK, 4)
    d.text((C1+36, y1+62),
           "\u201cA landmark shift in how clinical",
           font=fnt["SeI"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    d.text((C1+36, y1+128),
           "knowledge is accessed and applied.\u201d",
           font=fnt["SeI"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    d.text((C1+36, y1+186), "— Nature Medicine, 2023",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=MUTED, anchor="lm")
    y1 += 258

    # market bar chart
    d.text((C1, y1+36), "MARKET TRAJECTORY",
           font=fnt["MB"], fill=TEAL, anchor="lm")
    y1 += 92
    bars = [("2021",0.115,"$1.2B"), ("2022",0.275,"$2.9B"),
            ("2023",0.514,"$5.4B"), ("2030",1.0,  "$10.5B")]
    bmax  = 195
    btot  = col3w
    bw    = (btot - 3*40) // 4
    for bi,(yr,frac,lbl) in enumerate(bars):
        bx  = C1 + bi*(bw+40)
        bh  = int(bmax*frac)
        by_ = y1 + bmax - bh
        fc  = AMBER if bi==3 else TEAL
        rr(d, bx, by_, bx+bw, y1+bmax, 10, fc)
        d.text((bx+bw//2, y1+bmax+40), yr,
               font=fnt["MR"], fill=MUTED, anchor="mm")
        d.text((bx+bw//2, by_-30), lbl,
               font=fnt["MR"], fill=WHITE, anchor="mm")
    y1 += bmax + 115

    # applications
    sec_head(d, fnt, C1, y1+50, "02", "Applications", col3w, TEAL)
    y1 += 158
    apps_data = [
        ("Clinical Documentation",
         "Automated note generation, discharge summaries — earliest & widest real-world adoption"),
        ("Diagnostic Support",
         "Differential diagnosis generation, radiology report interpretation — active research"),
        ("Patient Communication",
         "Question answering, medical jargon simplification — early clinical deployment"),
        ("Medical Education",
         "Exam preparation, case-based tutoring — actively used by students globally"),
        ("Biomedical Research",
         "Literature synthesis, hypothesis generation, protocol drafting — emerging use"),
    ]
    for atitle, adesc in apps_data:
        y1 = app_card(d, fnt, C1, y1, C1+col3w, atitle, adesc)

    # === COLUMN 2 — Performance + Risks =======================================
    y2 = BODY_Y
    sec_head(d, fnt, C2, y2+50, "03", "Performance", col3w, TEAL_LT)
    y2 += 158

    y2 = tw(d,
        "Performance on standardized medical examinations has become the "
        "primary benchmark for LLM capability in medicine — though real-world "
        "clinical performance remains less well characterized.",
        fnt["SeR"], C2, y2, BODY, col3w, 1.45) + 55

    d.text((C2, y2), "USMLE PERFORMANCE BY MODEL",
           font=fnt["MB"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    y2 += 68

    # passing threshold x position
    ptx = C2 + int(col3w * 0.595)

    models = [
        ("GPT-4",      0.95,  ">90%",  TEAL),
        ("Med-PaLM 2", 0.865, "86.5%", TEAL_DK),
        ("GPT-3.5",    0.60,  "~60%",  MUTED),
    ]
    row_h = 130
    for mi,(mn,fr,pct,mc) in enumerate(models):
        by_ = y2 + mi*row_h
        bl  = int(col3w*fr)
        d.text((C2, by_-28), mn, font=fnt["SS"], fill=WHITE, anchor="lm")
        rr(d, C2, by_, C2+bl, by_+78, 12, mc)
        d.text((C2+bl+22, by_+39), pct,
               font=fnt["MB"], fill=mc, anchor="lm")

    th_bot = y2 + 3*row_h - 12
    d.line([(ptx, th_top),(ptx, th_bot)], fill=AMBER, width=6)
    rr(d, ptx-8, th_top-52, ptx+305, th_top-2, 8, AMBER)
    d.text((ptx+148, th_top-27), "Pass threshold ~60%",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=NAVY, anchor="mm")

    y2 += 3*row_h + 95

    # MedQA card
    d.text((C2, y2), "MedQA BENCHMARK",
           font=fnt["MB"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    y2 += 65
    rr(d, C2, y2, C2+col3w, y2+178, 20, CARD_BG, TEAL_DK, 5)
    d.text((C2+col3w//2, y2+66), "86.5%",
           font=fnt["MET_M"], fill=WHITE, anchor="mm")
    d.text((C2+col3w//2, y2+136),
           "Med-PaLM 2  \u00b7  Approaching expert physician performance",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=MUTED, anchor="mm")
    y2 += 212

    # caveat
    y2 = tw(d,
        "Note: Benchmark performance on multiple-choice examinations does not "
        "directly translate to safe clinical decision support. Prospective "
        "validation in real clinical settings remains limited.",
        fnt["SeS"], C2, y2+28, MUTED, col3w, 1.38) + 65

    # risks section
    sec_head(d, fnt, C2, y2+50, "04", "Risks & Ethics", col3w, AMBER)
    y2 += 158

    y2 = tw(d,
        "The gap between benchmark performance and safe deployment is defined "
        "by well-documented, serious risks — not engineering problems awaiting "
        "a patch, but fundamental characteristics of current LLM architecture.",
        fnt["SeR"], C2, y2, BODY, col3w, 1.45) + 48

    risks_data = [
        ("Hallucinations",
         "Up to 30% of outputs contain fabricated medical information or false citations, "
         "indistinguishable in style from accurate responses."),
        ("Bias & Equity",
         "Models perpetuate training-data biases, producing disparate care "
         "recommendations across demographic groups."),
        ("Privacy & Compliance",
         "Patient data in prompts may transit external servers, raising HIPAA/GDPR "
         "concerns that remain unresolved."),
        ("Lack of Clinical Validation",
         "Most evaluations rely on multiple-choice benchmarks, not prospective "

    y3 = tw(d,
        "Responsible clinical adoption requires a multi-stakeholder governance "
        "framework. The following five pillars represent the current expert "
        "consensus on minimum requirements for safe LLM deployment in "

        SS     = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",58),
        SXS    = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",50),
        SeB    = F("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf",     75),
        SeR    = F("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf",  70),
        SeS    = F("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf",  57),
        SeI    = F("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf",   62),
        MB     = F("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf",      58),
        MR     = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   50),
    )

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def hline(d, y, x0=0, x1=W, color=GRAY_RULE, width=4):
    d.line([(x0,y),(x1,y)], fill=color, width=width)

def rr(d, x0,y0,x1,y1, r, fill, outline=None, ow=0):
    d.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y1], radius=r,
                         fill=fill, outline=outline, width=ow)

def tw(d, txt, font, x, y, col, max_w, ls=1.42):
    """Word-wrap; returns y after last baseline."""
    words = txt.split()
    lines, cur = [], []
    for w in words:
        probe = " ".join(cur+[w])
        if d.textlength(probe, font=font) <= max_w:
            cur.append(w)
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
            cur = [w]
    if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
    bb = d.textbbox((0,0),"Hg",font=font)
    lh = (bb[3]-bb[1]) * ls
    for ln in lines:
        d.text((x,y), ln, font=font, fill=col, anchor="lm")
        y += lh
    return y

def sec_head(d, fonts, x, y, n, title, w, col=TEAL):
    R = 48
    # circle badge
    d.ellipse([x, y-R, x+R*2, y+R], fill=col)
    d.text((x+R, y), n, font=fonts["MB"], fill=NAVY, anchor="mm")
    d.text((x+R*2+40, y), title.upper(), font=fonts["H2b"], fill=WHITE, anchor="lm")
    hline(d, y+R+20, x0=x, x1=x+w, color=col, width=5)

def metric_card(d, fonts, x0,y0,x1,y1, val, lbl, ctx, accent, risk=False):
    bg = CARD_RISK if risk else CARD_BG
    rr(d, x0,y0,x1,y1, 24, bg, outline=accent, ow=6)
    bar = 16
    d.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y0+bar+24], radius=24, fill=accent)
    d.rectangle([x0,y0+24,x1,y0+bar+24], fill=accent)
    cx = (x0+x1)//2
    h = y1-y0
    vf = fonts["MET_L"] if len(val)>5 else fonts["MET_XL"]
    d.text((cx, y0+h*0.37), val, font=vf,
           fill=AMBER if risk else WHITE, anchor="mm")
    d.text((cx, y0+h*0.62), lbl, font=fonts["SB"], fill=accent, anchor="mm")
    tw(d, ctx, fonts["SeS"], x0+46, y0+h*0.80, MUTED, x1-x0-90, 1.30)

def app_card(d, fonts, x0,y0,x1, title, desc):
    h = 185
    rr(d, x0,y0,x1,y0+h, 14, (18,38,70), TEAL_DK, 3)
    d.text((x0+30, y0+54), title, font=fonts["SB"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    tw(d, desc, fonts["SeS"], x0+30, y0+128, MUTED, x1-x0-60, 1.30)
    return y0+h+20

def risk_item(d, fonts, x0, y, w, title, desc, accent=AMBER):
    d.rectangle([x0, y, x0+10, y+200], fill=accent)
    d.text((x0+38, y+50), title, font=fonts["SB"], fill=accent, anchor="lm")
    y2 = tw(d, desc, fonts["SeS"], x0+38, y+118, BODY, w-52, 1.35)
    return max(y2, y+200) + 22

def fw_card(d, fonts, x0,y0,x1, n, title, desc, accent):
    rr(d, x0,y0,x1,y0+260, 18, CARD_BG, outline=accent, ow=5)
    d.text((x0+44, y0+68), n, font=fonts["MB"], fill=accent, anchor="lm")
    d.text((x0+115, y0+68), title.upper(), font=fonts["SB"], fill=WHITE, anchor="lm")
    tw(d, desc, fonts["SeS"], x0+44, y0+150, MUTED, x1-x0-80, 1.35)
    return y0+280


# ── Render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def render():
    img  = Image.new("RGB", (W,H), NAVY)
    d    = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    fnt  = build_fonts()

    MAR     = 185
    GAP     = 88
    col3w   = (W - 2*MAR - 2*GAP) // 3
    C1, C2, C3 = MAR, MAR+col3w+GAP, MAR+2*(col3w+GAP)

    # ── Background diagonal texture ──────────────────────────────────────────
    for i in range(-H, W+H, 130):
        d.line([(i,0),(i+H,H)], fill=(13,27,52), width=2)

    # ── Top decorative stripe ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    d.rectangle([0,0,W,20], fill=TEAL)

    # ── Header ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    d.rectangle([0, 20, W, HDR_H], fill=HDR_BG)
    # conference bar
    d.rectangle([0, 20, W, 110], fill=(8, 20, 42))
    d.text((MAR, 64), "MEDICAL AI & DIGITAL HEALTH CONFERENCE 2024",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=TEAL, anchor="lm")
    d.text((W-MAR, 64), "ACADEMIC POSTER  ·  PEER-REVIEWED REVIEW",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=MUTED, anchor="rm")

    # Title
    d.text((MAR, 215), "LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS",
           font=fnt["H1"], fill=WHITE, anchor="lm")
    d.text((MAR, 430), "IN MEDICINE",
           font=fnt["H1"], fill=TEAL, anchor="lm")
    d.text((MAR, 542),
           "Opportunities, Risks, and the Path Forward  \u00b7  "
           "A Comprehensive Review  \u00b7  Nature Medicine, July 2023",
           font=fnt["SeI"], fill=MUTED, anchor="lm")

    # right accent bar
    d.rectangle([W-28, 0, W, HDR_H], fill=TEAL_DK)
    hline(d, HDR_H, color=TEAL, width=9)

    # ── Metric cards ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    MET_Y  = HDR_H + 72
    MET_H  = 460
    cardw  = (W - 2*MAR - 3*GAP) // 4

    metrics = [
        (">90%",      "GPT-4 USMLE Score",
         "Exceeded all 3 USMLE steps — well above the ~60% passing threshold",
         TEAL, False),
        ("500+",      "PubMed Articles (2023)",
         "Peer-reviewed LLM-in-medicine publications in a single calendar year",
         TEAL_LT, False),
        ("Up to 30%", "Hallucination Rate",
         "LLMs fabricate plausible but incorrect medical information in up to 30% of outputs",
         AMBER, True),
        ("$10.5B",    "Healthcare LLM Market 2030",
         "Projected global market for healthcare LLM applications",
         TEAL, False),
    ]
    for i,(val,lbl,ctx,acc,risk) in enumerate(metrics):
        x0 = MAR + i*(cardw+GAP)
        metric_card(d, fnt, x0, MET_Y, x0+cardw, MET_Y+MET_H,
                    val, lbl, ctx, acc, risk)

    hline(d, MET_Y+MET_H+78, color=GRAY_RULE, width=4)

    # ── Body top ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    BODY_Y = MET_Y + MET_H + 118

    # === COLUMN 1 — Overview + Applications ===================================
    y1 = BODY_Y
    sec_head(d, fnt, C1, y1+50, "01", "Overview", col3w, TEAL)
    y1 += 158

    y1 = tw(d,
        "Large language models (LLMs) — GPT-4, Med-PaLM 2, and LLaMA — are "
        "transformer-based foundation models trained on vast text corpora. "
        "They have entered healthcare with extraordinary velocity, demonstrating "
        "capabilities in medical knowledge retrieval and clinical reasoning "
        "unimaginable just three years ago.",
        fnt["SeR"], C1, y1, BODY, col3w, 1.45) + 52

    # pull quote
    rr(d, C1, y1, C1+col3w, y1+218, 16, (14,28,58), TEAL_DK, 4)
    d.text((C1+36, y1+62),
           "\u201cA landmark shift in how clinical",
           font=fnt["SeI"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    d.text((C1+36, y1+128),
           "knowledge is accessed and applied.\u201d",
           font=fnt["SeI"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    d.text((C1+36, y1+186), "— Nature Medicine, 2023",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=MUTED, anchor="lm")
    y1 += 258

    # market bar chart
    d.text((C1, y1+36), "MARKET TRAJECTORY",
           font=fnt["MB"], fill=TEAL, anchor="lm")
    y1 += 92
    bars = [("2021",0.115,"$1.2B"), ("2022",0.275,"$2.9B"),
            ("2023",0.514,"$5.4B"), ("2030",1.0,  "$10.5B")]
    bmax  = 195
    btot  = col3w
    bw    = (btot - 3*40) // 4
    for bi,(yr,frac,lbl) in enumerate(bars):

        by_ = y1 + bmax - bh
        fc  = AMBER if bi==3 else TEAL
        rr(d, bx, by_, bx+bw, y1+bmax, 10, fc)
        d.text((bx+bw//2, y1+bmax+40), yr,
               font=fnt["MR"], fill=MUTED, anchor="mm")
        d.text((bx+bw//2, by_-30), lbl,
               font=fnt["MR"], fill=WHITE, anchor="mm")
    y1 += bmax + 115

    # applications
    sec_head(d, fnt, C1, y1+50, "02", "Applications", col3w, TEAL)
    y1 += 158
    apps_data = [
        ("Clinical Documentation",
         "Automated note generation, discharge summaries — earliest & widest real-world adoption"),
        ("Diagnostic Support",
         "Differential diagnosis generation, radiology report interpretation — active research"),
        ("Patient Communication",
         "Question answering, medical jargon simplification — early clinical deployment"),
        ("Medical Education",
         "Exam preparation, case-based tutoring — actively used by students globally"),
        ("Biomedical Research",
         "Literature synthesis, hypothesis generation, protocol drafting — emerging use"),

    for atitle, adesc in apps_data:
        y1 = app_card(d, fnt, C1, y1, C1+col3w, atitle, adesc)

    # === COLUMN 2 — Performance + Risks =======================================
    y2 = BODY_Y
    sec_head(d, fnt, C2, y2+50, "03", "Performance", col3w, TEAL_LT)
    y2 += 158

    y2 = tw(d,
        "Performance on standardized medical examinations has become the "
        "primary benchmark for LLM capability in medicine — though real-world "
        "clinical performance remains less well characterized.",
        fnt["SeR"], C2, y2, BODY, col3w, 1.45) + 55

    d.text((C2, y2), "USMLE PERFORMANCE BY MODEL",
           font=fnt["MB"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    y2 += 68

    # passing threshold x position
    ptx = C2 + int(col3w * 0.595)

    models = [
        ("GPT-4",      0.95,  ">90%",  TEAL),
        ("Med-PaLM 2", 0.865, "86.5%", TEAL_DK),
        ("GPT-3.5",    0.60,  "~60%",  MUTED),
    ]
    row_h = 130
    for mi,(mn,fr,pct,mc) in enumerate(models):
        by_ = y2 + mi*row_h
        bl  = int(col3w*fr)
        d.text((C2, by_-28), mn, font=fnt["SS"], fill=WHITE, anchor="lm")
        rr(d, C2, by_, C2+bl, by_+78, 12, mc)
        d.text((C2+bl+22, by_+39), pct,
               font=fnt["MB"], fill=mc, anchor="lm")

    # threshold line
    th_top = y2 - 42
    th_bot = y2 + 3*row_h - 12
    d.line([(ptx, th_top),(ptx, th_bot)], fill=AMBER, width=6)
    rr(d, ptx-8, th_top-52, ptx+305, th_top-2, 8, AMBER)
    d.text((ptx+148, th_top-27), "Pass threshold ~60%",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=NAVY, anchor="mm")

    y2 += 3*row_h + 95

    # MedQA card
    d.text((C2, y2), "MedQA BENCHMARK",
           font=fnt["MB"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    y2 += 65
    rr(d, C2, y2, C2+col3w, y2+178, 20, CARD_BG, TEAL_DK, 5)
    d.text((C2+col3w//2, y2+66), "86.5%",
           font=fnt["MET_M"], fill=WHITE, anchor="mm")
    d.text((C2+col3w//2, y2+136),
           "Med-PaLM 2  \u00b7  Approaching expert physician performance",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=MUTED, anchor="mm")
    y2 += 212

    # caveat
    y2 = tw(d,
        "Note: Benchmark performance on multiple-choice examinations does not "
        "directly translate to safe clinical decision support. Prospective "
        "validation in real clinical settings remains limited.",
        fnt["SeS"], C2, y2+28, MUTED, col3w, 1.38) + 65

    # risks section
    sec_head(d, fnt, C2, y2+50, "04", "Risks & Ethics", col3w, AMBER)
    y2 += 158

    y2 = tw(d,
        "The gap between benchmark performance and safe deployment is defined "
        "by well-documented, serious risks — not engineering problems awaiting "
        "a patch, but fundamental characteristics of current LLM architecture.",
        fnt["SeR"], C2, y2, BODY, col3w, 1.45) + 48

    risks_data = [
        ("Hallucinations",
         "Up to 30% of outputs contain fabricated medical information or false citations, "
         "indistinguishable in style from accurate responses."),
        ("Bias & Equity",
         "Models perpetuate training-data biases, producing disparate care "
         "recommendations across demographic groups."),
        ("Privacy & Compliance",
         "Patient data in prompts may transit external servers, raising HIPAA/GDPR "
         "concerns that remain unresolved."),
        ("Lack of Clinical Validation",
         "Most evaluations rely on multiple-choice benchmarks, not prospective "
         "trials with patient outcome endpoints."),
        ("Automation Bias",
         "Clinicians risk accepting LLM outputs without critical appraisal — "
         "especially dangerous in time-pressured settings."),
    ]
    for rtitle, rdesc in risks_data:
        y2 = risk_item(d, fnt, C2, y2, col3w, rtitle, rdesc)

    # === COLUMN 3 — Framework =================================================

    sec_head(d, fnt, C3, y3+50, "05", "Deployment Framework", col3w, TEAL_LT)
    y3 += 158

    y3 = tw(d,
        "Responsible clinical adoption requires a multi-stakeholder governance "
        "framework. The following five pillars represent the current expert "
        "consensus on minimum requirements for safe LLM deployment in "
        "healthcare settings.",
        fnt["SeR"], C3, y3, BODY, col3w, 1.45) + 65

        (TEAL,    "01", "Rigorous Prospective Evaluation",

         "not solely on retrospective benchmark data."),
        (TEAL_LT, "02", "Human-in-the-Loop Design",
         "Clinician oversight of every LLM-generated output is non-negotiable. "
         "LLMs augment, never replace, clinical judgment."),
        (TEAL_DK, "03", "Transparent Reporting",
         "Disclose model limitations, training data provenance, and known failure "
         "modes to all clinical users and patients."),
        (TEAL,    "04", "Equity Audits",
         "Assess differential performance across patient subpopulations before "
         "and after deployment. Correct disparities systematically."),
        (AMBER,   "05", "Regulatory Alignment",
         "Ensure compliance with evolving FDA, EMA, and WHO guidance on "
         "AI-based medical devices and clinical decision support tools."),
    ]
    for pcol, pnum, ptitle, pdesc in pillars:
        y3 = fw_card(d, fnt, C3, y3, C3+col3w, pnum, ptitle, pdesc, pcol)

    # consensus statement
    y3 += 42
    d.text((C3, y3), "EXPERT CONSENSUS",
           font=fnt["MB"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    y3 += 60
    rr(d, C3, y3, C3+col3w, y3+330, 22, (7,18,40), TEAL, 7)
    y3c = y3 + 72
    y3c = tw(d,
        "\u201cLLMs hold transformative potential for medicine. "
        "Their deployment must be guided by evidence, equity, "
        "and robust governance to ensure patient safety.\u201d",
        fnt["SeR"], C3+48, y3c, WHITE, col3w-95, 1.50)
    d.text((C3+48, y3c+28), "\u2014 Moor et al., Nature Medicine 2023",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=MUTED, anchor="lm")

    # ── Subtle LLM watermark ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    wm   = Image.new("RGBA", (1600, 440), (0,0,0,0))
    wmd  = ImageDraw.Draw(wm)
    wmd.text((0, 220), "LLM",

             fill=(255,255,255,12), anchor="lm")
    wm_r = wm.rotate(90, expand=True)
    base = img.convert("RGBA")
    base.paste(wm_r, (W - MAR//2 - 160, 1000), wm_r)
    img  = base.convert("RGB")
    d    = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    # ── Column dividers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    FTR_TOP = H - 210
    for dx in [C2 - GAP//2, C3 - GAP//2]:
        d.line([(dx, BODY_Y+10),(dx, FTR_TOP-10)], fill=GRAY_RULE, width=3)

    # ── Footer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    d.rectangle([0, FTR_TOP, W, H], fill=HDR_BG)
    hline(d, FTR_TOP, color=TEAL, width=7)
    hline(d, H-20, color=TEAL, width=18)
    d.text((MAR, FTR_TOP+75),
           "Moor, M. et al. Foundation Models for Generalist Medical AI.",

    d.text((MAR, FTR_TOP+142),
           "Nature Medicine 29, 1894\u20131904 (2023).  "
           "https://doi.org/10.1038/s41591-023-02448-8",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=MUTED, anchor="lm")
    d.text((W-MAR, FTR_TOP+108),
           "Medical AI & Digital Health Conference 2024",
           font=fnt["SS"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="rm")

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    img.save(OUT_PATH, "PNG", dpi=(DPI,DPI), optimize=False)
    print(f"Saved \u2192 {OUT_PATH}  ({W}\u00d7{H} px)")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    render()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Refined render — LLMs in Medicine academic poster
A0 portrait @ 150 dpi  →  4967 × 7020 px
"""
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os, math

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
OUT_PATH  = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
DPI       = 150
W, H      = 4967, 7020

# ── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = (10,  23,  48)
WHITE      = (255, 255, 255)
TEAL       = (58, 148, 168)
TEAL_LT    = (120, 195, 215)
TEAL_DK    = (35,  90, 110)
TEAL_PALE  = (180, 225, 235)
AMBER      = (225, 148,  50)
AMBER_PALE = (248, 210, 155)
GRAY_RULE  = (38,  60,  92)
CARD_BG    = (16,  36,  64)
CARD_RISK  = (32,  18,  10)
BODY       = (205, 220, 238)
MUTED      = (118, 148, 178)
SOFT_BG    = (14,  30,  58)
HDR_BG     = (6,   16,  34)

def F(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

def build_fonts():
    return dict(
        H1     = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf",    300),
        H1b    = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf",    240),
        H2     = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf",    120),
        H2b    = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf",     96),
        H3     = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf",     78),
        MET_XL = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf",        260),
        MET_L  = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf",        200),
        MET_M  = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf",        140),
        SB     = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",   82),
        SR     = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",72),
        SS     = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",58),
        SXS    = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",50),
        SeB    = F("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf",     75),
        SeR    = F("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf",  70),
        SeS    = F("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf",  57),
        SeI    = F("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf",   62),
        MB     = F("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf",      58),
        MR     = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   50),
    )

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def hline(d, y, x0=0, x1=W, color=GRAY_RULE, width=4):
    d.line([(x0,y),(x1,y)], fill=color, width=width)

def rr(d, x0,y0,x1,y1, r, fill, outline=None, ow=0):
    d.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y1], radius=r,
                         fill=fill, outline=outline, width=ow)

def tw(d, txt, font, x, y, col, max_w, ls=1.42):
    """Word-wrap; returns y after last baseline."""
    words = txt.split()
    lines, cur = [], []
    for w in words:
        probe = " ".join(cur+[w])
        if d.textlength(probe, font=font) <= max_w:
            cur.append(w)
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
            cur = [w]
    if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
    bb = d.textbbox((0,0),"Hg",font=font)
    lh = (bb[3]-bb[1]) * ls
    for ln in lines:
        d.text((x,y), ln, font=font, fill=col, anchor="lm")
        y += lh
    return y

def sec_head(d, fonts, x, y, n, title, w, col=TEAL):
    R = 48
    # circle badge
    d.ellipse([x, y-R, x+R*2, y+R], fill=col)
    d.text((x+R, y), n, font=fonts["MB"], fill=NAVY, anchor="mm")
    d.text((x+R*2+40, y), title.upper(), font=fonts["H2b"], fill=WHITE, anchor="lm")
    hline(d, y+R+20, x0=x, x1=x+w, color=col, width=5)

def metric_card(d, fonts, x0,y0,x1,y1, val, lbl, ctx, accent, risk=False):
    bg = CARD_RISK if risk else CARD_BG
    rr(d, x0,y0,x1,y1, 24, bg, outline=accent, ow=6)
    bar = 16
    d.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y0+bar+24], radius=24, fill=accent)
    d.rectangle([x0,y0+24,x1,y0+bar+24], fill=accent)
    cx = (x0+x1)//2
    h = y1-y0
    vf = fonts["MET_L"] if len(val)>5 else fonts["MET_XL"]
    d.text((cx, y0+h*0.37), val, font=vf,
           fill=AMBER if risk else WHITE, anchor="mm")
    d.text((cx, y0+h*0.62), lbl, font=fonts["SB"], fill=accent, anchor="mm")
    tw(d, ctx, fonts["SeS"], x0+46, y0+h*0.80, MUTED, x1-x0-90, 1.30)

def app_card(d, fonts, x0,y0,x1, title, desc):
    h = 185
    rr(d, x0,y0,x1,y0+h, 14, (18,38,70), TEAL_DK, 3)
    d.text((x0+30, y0+54), title, font=fonts["SB"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    tw(d, desc, fonts["SeS"], x0+30, y0+128, MUTED, x1-x0-60, 1.30)
    return y0+h+20

def risk_item(d, fonts, x0, y, w, title, desc, accent=AMBER):
    d.rectangle([x0, y, x0+10, y+200], fill=accent)
    d.text((x0+38, y+50), title, font=fonts["SB"], fill=accent, anchor="lm")
    y2 = tw(d, desc, fonts["SeS"], x0+38, y+118, BODY, w-52, 1.35)
    return max(y2, y+200) + 22

def fw_card(d, fonts, x0,y0,x1, n, title, desc, accent):
    rr(d, x0,y0,x1,y0+260, 18, CARD_BG, outline=accent, ow=5)
    d.text((x0+44, y0+68), n, font=fonts["MB"], fill=accent, anchor="lm")
    d.text((x0+115, y0+68), title.upper(), font=fonts["SB"], fill=WHITE, anchor="lm")
    tw(d, desc, fonts["SeS"], x0+44, y0+150, MUTED, x1-x0-80, 1.35)
    return y0+280


# ── Render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def render():
    img  = Image.new("RGB", (W,H), NAVY)
    d    = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    fnt  = build_fonts()

    MAR     = 185
    GAP     = 88
    col3w   = (W - 2*MAR - 2*GAP) // 3
    C1, C2, C3 = MAR, MAR+col3w+GAP, MAR+2*(col3w+GAP)

    # ── Background diagonal texture ──────────────────────────────────────────
    for i in range(-H, W+H, 130):
        d.line([(i,0),(i+H,H)], fill=(13,27,52), width=2)

    # ── Top decorative stripe ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    d.rectangle([0,0,W,20], fill=TEAL)

    # ── Header ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    HDR_H = 620
    d.rectangle([0, 20, W, HDR_H], fill=HDR_BG)
    # conference bar
    d.rectangle([0, 20, W, 110], fill=(8, 20, 42))
    d.text((MAR, 64), "MEDICAL AI & DIGITAL HEALTH CONFERENCE 2024",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=TEAL, anchor="lm")
    d.text((W-MAR, 64), "ACADEMIC POSTER  ·  PEER-REVIEWED REVIEW",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=MUTED, anchor="rm")

    # Title
    d.text((MAR, 215), "LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS",
           font=fnt["H1"], fill=WHITE, anchor="lm")
    d.text((MAR, 430), "IN MEDICINE",
           font=fnt["H1"], fill=TEAL, anchor="lm")
    d.text((MAR, 542),
           "Opportunities, Risks, and the Path Forward  \u00b7  "
           "A Comprehensive Review  \u00b7  Nature Medicine, July 2023",
           font=fnt["SeI"], fill=MUTED, anchor="lm")

    # right accent bar
    d.rectangle([W-28, 0, W, HDR_H], fill=TEAL_DK)
    hline(d, HDR_H, color=TEAL, width=9)

    # ── Metric cards ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    MET_Y  = HDR_H + 72
    MET_H  = 460
    cardw  = (W - 2*MAR - 3*GAP) // 4

    metrics = [
        (">90%",      "GPT-4 USMLE Score",
         "Exceeded all 3 USMLE steps — well above the ~60% passing threshold",
         TEAL, False),
        ("500+",      "PubMed Articles (2023)",
         "Peer-reviewed LLM-in-medicine publications in a single calendar year",
         TEAL_LT, False),
        ("Up to 30%", "Hallucination Rate",
         "LLMs fabricate plausible but incorrect medical information in up to 30% of outputs",
         AMBER, True),
        ("$10.5B",    "Healthcare LLM Market 2030",
         "Projected global market for healthcare LLM applications",
         TEAL, False),
    ]
    for i,(val,lbl,ctx,acc,risk) in enumerate(metrics):
        x0 = MAR + i*(cardw+GAP)
        metric_card(d, fnt, x0, MET_Y, x0+cardw, MET_Y+MET_H,
                    val, lbl, ctx, acc, risk)

    hline(d, MET_Y+MET_H+78, color=GRAY_RULE, width=4)

    # ── Body top ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    BODY_Y = MET_Y + MET_H + 118

    # === COLUMN 1 — Overview + Applications ===================================
    y1 = BODY_Y
    sec_head(d, fnt, C1, y1+50, "01", "Overview", col3w, TEAL)
    y1 += 158

    y1 = tw(d,
        "Large language models (LLMs) — GPT-4, Med-PaLM 2, and LLaMA — are "
        "transformer-based foundation models trained on vast text corpora. "
        "They have entered healthcare with extraordinary velocity, demonstrating "
        "capabilities in medical knowledge retrieval and clinical reasoning "
        "unimaginable just three years ago.",
        fnt["SeR"], C1, y1, BODY, col3w, 1.45) + 52

    # pull quote
    rr(d, C1, y1, C1+col3w, y1+218, 16, (14,28,58), TEAL_DK, 4)
    d.text((C1+36, y1+62),
           "\u201cA landmark shift in how clinical",
           font=fnt["SeI"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    d.text((C1+36, y1+128),
           "knowledge is accessed and applied.\u201d",
           font=fnt["SeI"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    d.text((C1+36, y1+186), "— Nature Medicine, 2023",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=MUTED, anchor="lm")
    y1 += 258

    # market bar chart
    d.text((C1, y1+36), "MARKET TRAJECTORY",
           font=fnt["MB"], fill=TEAL, anchor="lm")
    y1 += 92
    bars = [("2021",0.115,"$1.2B"), ("2022",0.275,"$2.9B"),
            ("2023",0.514,"$5.4B"), ("2030",1.0,  "$10.5B")]
    bmax  = 195
    btot  = col3w
    bw    = (btot - 3*40) // 4
    for bi,(yr,frac,lbl) in enumerate(bars):
        bx  = C1 + bi*(bw+40)
        bh  = int(bmax*frac)
        by_ = y1 + bmax - bh
        fc  = AMBER if bi==3 else TEAL
        rr(d, bx, by_, bx+bw, y1+bmax, 10, fc)
        d.text((bx+bw//2, y1+bmax+40), yr,
               font=fnt["MR"], fill=MUTED, anchor="mm")
        d.text((bx+bw//2, by_-30), lbl,
               font=fnt["MR"], fill=WHITE, anchor="mm")
    y1 += bmax + 115

    # applications
    sec_head(d, fnt, C1, y1+50, "02", "Applications", col3w, TEAL)
    y1 += 158
    apps_data = [
        ("Clinical Documentation",
         "Automated note generation, discharge summaries — earliest & widest real-world adoption"),
        ("Diagnostic Support",
         "Differential diagnosis generation, radiology report interpretation — active research"),
        ("Patient Communication",
         "Question answering, medical jargon simplification — early clinical deployment"),
        ("Medical Education",
         "Exam preparation, case-based tutoring — actively used by students globally"),
        ("Biomedical Research",
         "Literature synthesis, hypothesis generation, protocol drafting — emerging use"),
    ]
    for atitle, adesc in apps_data:
        y1 = app_card(d, fnt, C1, y1, C1+col3w, atitle, adesc)

    # === COLUMN 2 — Performance + Risks =======================================
    y2 = BODY_Y
    sec_head(d, fnt, C2, y2+50, "03", "Performance", col3w, TEAL_LT)
    y2 += 158

    y2 = tw(d,
        "Performance on standardized medical examinations has become the "
        "primary benchmark for LLM capability in medicine — though real-world "
        "clinical performance remains less well characterized.",
        fnt["SeR"], C2, y2, BODY, col3w, 1.45) + 55

    d.text((C2, y2), "USMLE PERFORMANCE BY MODEL",
           font=fnt["MB"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    y2 += 68

    # passing threshold x position
    ptx = C2 + int(col3w * 0.595)

    models = [
        ("GPT-4",      0.95,  ">90%",  TEAL),
        ("Med-PaLM 2", 0.865, "86.5%", TEAL_DK),
        ("GPT-3.5",    0.60,  "~60%",  MUTED),
    ]
    row_h = 130
    for mi,(mn,fr,pct,mc) in enumerate(models):
        by_ = y2 + mi*row_h
        bl  = int(col3w*fr)
        d.text((C2, by_-28), mn, font=fnt["SS"], fill=WHITE, anchor="lm")
        rr(d, C2, by_, C2+bl, by_+78, 12, mc)
        d.text((C2+bl+22, by_+39), pct,
               font=fnt["MB"], fill=mc, anchor="lm")

    # threshold line
    th_top = y2 - 42
    th_bot = y2 + 3*row_h - 12
    d.line([(ptx, th_top),(ptx, th_bot)], fill=AMBER, width=6)
    rr(d, ptx-8, th_top-52, ptx+305, th_top-2, 8, AMBER)
    d.text((ptx+148, th_top-27), "Pass threshold ~60%",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=NAVY, anchor="mm")

    y2 += 3*row_h + 95

    # MedQA card
    d.text((C2, y2), "MedQA BENCHMARK",
           font=fnt["MB"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    y2 += 65
    rr(d, C2, y2, C2+col3w, y2+178, 20, CARD_BG, TEAL_DK, 5)
    d.text((C2+col3w//2, y2+66), "86.5%",
           font=fnt["MET_M"], fill=WHITE, anchor="mm")
    d.text((C2+col3w//2, y2+136),
           "Med-PaLM 2  \u00b7  Approaching expert physician performance",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=MUTED, anchor="mm")
    y2 += 212

    # caveat
    y2 = tw(d,
        "Note: Benchmark performance on multiple-choice examinations does not "
        "directly translate to safe clinical decision support. Prospective "
        "validation in real clinical settings remains limited.",
        fnt["SeS"], C2, y2+28, MUTED, col3w, 1.38) + 65

    # risks section
    sec_head(d, fnt, C2, y2+50, "04", "Risks & Ethics", col3w, AMBER)
    y2 += 158

    y2 = tw(d,
        "The gap between benchmark performance and safe deployment is defined "
        "by well-documented, serious risks — not engineering problems awaiting "
        "a patch, but fundamental characteristics of current LLM architecture.",
        fnt["SeR"], C2, y2, BODY, col3w, 1.45) + 48

    risks_data = [
        ("Hallucinations",
         "Up to 30% of outputs contain fabricated medical information or false citations, "
         "indistinguishable in style from accurate responses."),
        ("Bias & Equity",
         "Models perpetuate training-data biases, producing disparate care "
         "recommendations across demographic groups."),
        ("Privacy & Compliance",
         "Patient data in prompts may transit external servers, raising HIPAA/GDPR "
         "concerns that remain unresolved."),
        ("Lack of Clinical Validation",
         "Most evaluations rely on multiple-choice benchmarks, not prospective "
         "trials with patient outcome endpoints."),
        ("Automation Bias",
         "Clinicians risk accepting LLM outputs without critical appraisal — "
         "especially dangerous in time-pressured settings."),
    ]
    for rtitle, rdesc in risks_data:
        y2 = risk_item(d, fnt, C2, y2, col3w, rtitle, rdesc)

    # === COLUMN 3 — Framework =================================================
    y3 = BODY_Y
    sec_head(d, fnt, C3, y3+50, "05", "Deployment Framework", col3w, TEAL_LT)
    y3 += 158

    y3 = tw(d,
        "Responsible clinical adoption requires a multi-stakeholder governance "
        "framework. The following five pillars represent the current expert "
        "consensus on minimum requirements for safe LLM deployment in "
        "healthcare settings.",
        fnt["SeR"], C3, y3, BODY, col3w, 1.45) + 65

    pillars = [
        (TEAL,    "01", "Rigorous Prospective Evaluation",
         "Deploy only after evaluation in diverse real-world clinical settings — "
         "not solely on retrospective benchmark data."),
        (TEAL_LT, "02", "Human-in-the-Loop Design",
         "Clinician oversight of every LLM-generated output is non-negotiable. "
         "LLMs augment, never replace, clinical judgment."),
        (TEAL_DK, "03", "Transparent Reporting",
         "Disclose model limitations, training data provenance, and known failure "
         "modes to all clinical users and patients."),
        (TEAL,    "04", "Equity Audits",
         "Assess differential performance across patient subpopulations before "
         "and after deployment. Correct disparities systematically."),
        (AMBER,   "05", "Regulatory Alignment",
         "Ensure compliance with evolving FDA, EMA, and WHO guidance on "
         "AI-based medical devices and clinical decision support tools."),
    ]
    for pcol, pnum, ptitle, pdesc in pillars:
        y3 = fw_card(d, fnt, C3, y3, C3+col3w, pnum, ptitle, pdesc, pcol)

    # consensus statement
    y3 += 42
    d.text((C3, y3), "EXPERT CONSENSUS",
           font=fnt["MB"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    y3 += 60
    rr(d, C3, y3, C3+col3w, y3+330, 22, (7,18,40), TEAL, 7)
    y3c = y3 + 72
    y3c = tw(d,
        "\u201cLLMs hold transformative potential for medicine. "
        "Their deployment must be guided by evidence, equity, "
        "and robust governance to ensure patient safety.\u201d",
        fnt["SeR"], C3+48, y3c, WHITE, col3w-95, 1.50)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Refined render — LLMs in Medicine academic poster
A0 portrait @ 150 dpi  →  4967 × 7020 px
"""
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os, math

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
OUT_PATH  = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
DPI       = 150
W, H      = 4967, 7020

# ── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = (10,  23,  48)
WHITE      = (255, 255, 255)
TEAL       = (58, 148, 168)
TEAL_LT    = (120, 195, 215)
TEAL_DK    = (35,  90, 110)
TEAL_PALE  = (180, 225, 235)
AMBER      = (225, 148,  50)
AMBER_PALE = (248, 210, 155)
GRAY_RULE  = (38,  60,  92)
CARD_BG    = (16,  36,  64)
CARD_RISK  = (32,  18,  10)
BODY       = (205, 220, 238)
MUTED      = (118, 148, 178)
SOFT_BG    = (14,  30,  58)
HDR_BG     = (6,   16,  34)

def F(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

def build_fonts():
    return dict(
        H1     = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf",    300),
        H1b    = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf",    240),
        H2     = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf",    120),
        H2b    = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf",     96),
        H3     = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf",     78),
        MET_XL = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf",        260),
        MET_L  = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf",        200),
        MET_M  = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf",        140),
        SB     = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",   82),
        SR     = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",72),
        SS     = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",58),
        SXS    = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",50),
        SeB    = F("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf",     75),
        SeR    = F("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf",  70),
        SeS    = F("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf",  57),
        SeI    = F("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf",   62),
        MB     = F("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf",      58),
        MR     = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   50),
    )

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def hline(d, y, x0=0, x1=W, color=GRAY_RULE, width=4):
    d.line([(x0,y),(x1,y)], fill=color, width=width)

def rr(d, x0,y0,x1,y1, r, fill, outline=None, ow=0):
    d.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y1], radius=r,
                         fill=fill, outline=outline, width=ow)

def tw(d, txt, font, x, y, col, max_w, ls=1.42):
    """Word-wrap; returns y after last baseline."""
    words = txt.split()
    lines, cur = [], []
    for w in words:
        probe = " ".join(cur+[w])
        if d.textlength(probe, font=font) <= max_w:
            cur.append(w)
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
            cur = [w]
    if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
    bb = d.textbbox((0,0),"Hg",font=font)
    lh = (bb[3]-bb[1]) * ls
    for ln in lines:
        d.text((x,y), ln, font=font, fill=col, anchor="lm")
        y += lh
    return y

def sec_head(d, fonts, x, y, n, title, w, col=TEAL):
    R = 48
    # circle badge
    d.ellipse([x, y-R, x+R*2, y+R], fill=col)
    d.text((x+R, y), n, font=fonts["MB"], fill=NAVY, anchor="mm")
    d.text((x+R*2+40, y), title.upper(), font=fonts["H2b"], fill=WHITE, anchor="lm")
    hline(d, y+R+20, x0=x, x1=x+w, color=col, width=5)

def metric_card(d, fonts, x0,y0,x1,y1, val, lbl, ctx, accent, risk=False):
    bg = CARD_RISK if risk else CARD_BG
    rr(d, x0,y0,x1,y1, 24, bg, outline=accent, ow=6)
    bar = 16
    d.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y0+bar+24], radius=24, fill=accent)
    d.rectangle([x0,y0+24,x1,y0+bar+24], fill=accent)
    cx = (x0+x1)//2
    h = y1-y0
    vf = fonts["MET_L"] if len(val)>5 else fonts["MET_XL"]
    d.text((cx, y0+h*0.37), val, font=vf,
           fill=AMBER if risk else WHITE, anchor="mm")
    d.text((cx, y0+h*0.62), lbl, font=fonts["SB"], fill=accent, anchor="mm")
    tw(d, ctx, fonts["SeS"], x0+46, y0+h*0.80, MUTED, x1-x0-90, 1.30)

def app_card(d, fonts, x0,y0,x1, title, desc):
    h = 185
    rr(d, x0,y0,x1,y0+h, 14, (18,38,70), TEAL_DK, 3)
    d.text((x0+30, y0+54), title, font=fonts["SB"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    tw(d, desc, fonts["SeS"], x0+30, y0+128, MUTED, x1-x0-60, 1.30)
    return y0+h+20

def risk_item(d, fonts, x0, y, w, title, desc, accent=AMBER):
    d.rectangle([x0, y, x0+10, y+200], fill=accent)
    d.text((x0+38, y+50), title, font=fonts["SB"], fill=accent, anchor="lm")
    y2 = tw(d, desc, fonts["SeS"], x0+38, y+118, BODY, w-52, 1.35)
    return max(y2, y+200) + 22

def fw_card(d, fonts, x0,y0,x1, n, title, desc, accent):
    rr(d, x0,y0,x1,y0+260, 18, CARD_BG, outline=accent, ow=5)
    d.text((x0+44, y0+68), n, font=fonts["MB"], fill=accent, anchor="lm")
    d.text((x0+115, y0+68), title.upper(), font=fonts["SB"], fill=WHITE, anchor="lm")
    tw(d, desc, fonts["SeS"], x0+44, y0+150, MUTED, x1-x0-80, 1.35)
    return y0+280


# ── Render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def render():
    img  = Image.new("RGB", (W,H), NAVY)
    d    = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    fnt  = build_fonts()

    MAR     = 185
    GAP     = 88
    col3w   = (W - 2*MAR - 2*GAP) // 3
    C1, C2, C3 = MAR, MAR+col3w+GAP, MAR+2*(col3w+GAP)

    # ── Background diagonal texture ──────────────────────────────────────────
    for i in range(-H, W+H, 130):
        d.line([(i,0),(i+H,H)], fill=(13,27,52), width=2)

    # ── Top decorative stripe ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    d.rectangle([0,0,W,20], fill=TEAL)

    # ── Header ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    HDR_H = 620
    d.rectangle([0, 20, W, HDR_H], fill=HDR_BG)
    # conference bar
    d.rectangle([0, 20, W, 110], fill=(8, 20, 42))
    d.text((MAR, 64), "MEDICAL AI & DIGITAL HEALTH CONFERENCE 2024",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=TEAL, anchor="lm")
    d.text((W-MAR, 64), "ACADEMIC POSTER  ·  PEER-REVIEWED REVIEW",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=MUTED, anchor="rm")

    # Title
    d.text((MAR, 215), "LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS",
           font=fnt["H1"], fill=WHITE, anchor="lm")
    d.text((MAR, 430), "IN MEDICINE",
           font=fnt["H1"], fill=TEAL, anchor="lm")
    d.text((MAR, 542),
           "Opportunities, Risks, and the Path Forward  \u00b7  "
           "A Comprehensive Review  \u00b7  Nature Medicine, July 2023",
           font=fnt["SeI"], fill=MUTED, anchor="lm")

    # right accent bar
    d.rectangle([W-28, 0, W, HDR_H], fill=TEAL_DK)
    hline(d, HDR_H, color=TEAL, width=9)

    # ── Metric cards ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    MET_Y  = HDR_H + 72
    MET_H  = 460
    cardw  = (W - 2*MAR - 3*GAP) // 4

    metrics = [
        (">90%",      "GPT-4 USMLE Score",
         "Exceeded all 3 USMLE steps — well above the ~60% passing threshold",
         TEAL, False),
        ("500+",      "PubMed Articles (2023)",
         "Peer-reviewed LLM-in-medicine publications in a single calendar year",
         TEAL_LT, False),
        ("Up to 30%", "Hallucination Rate",
         "LLMs fabricate plausible but incorrect medical information in up to 30% of outputs",
         AMBER, True),
        ("$10.5B",    "Healthcare LLM Market 2030",
         "Projected global market for healthcare LLM applications",
         TEAL, False),
    ]
    for i,(val,lbl,ctx,acc,risk) in enumerate(metrics):
        x0 = MAR + i*(cardw+GAP)
        metric_card(d, fnt, x0, MET_Y, x0+cardw, MET_Y+MET_H,
                    val, lbl, ctx, acc, risk)

    hline(d, MET_Y+MET_H+78, color=GRAY_RULE, width=4)

    # ── Body top ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    BODY_Y = MET_Y + MET_H + 118

    # === COLUMN 1 — Overview + Applications ===================================
    y1 = BODY_Y
    sec_head(d, fnt, C1, y1+50, "01", "Overview", col3w, TEAL)
    y1 += 158

    y1 = tw(d,
        "Large language models (LLMs) — GPT-4, Med-PaLM 2, and LLaMA — are "
        "transformer-based foundation models trained on vast text corpora. "
        "They have entered healthcare with extraordinary velocity, demonstrating "
        "capabilities in medical knowledge retrieval and clinical reasoning "
        "unimaginable just three years ago.",
        fnt["SeR"], C1, y1, BODY, col3w, 1.45) + 52

    # pull quote
    rr(d, C1, y1, C1+col3w, y1+218, 16, (14,28,58), TEAL_DK, 4)
    d.text((C1+36, y1+62),
           "\u201cA landmark shift in how clinical",
           font=fnt["SeI"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    d.text((C1+36, y1+128),
           "knowledge is accessed and applied.\u201d",
           font=fnt["SeI"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    d.text((C1+36, y1+186), "— Nature Medicine, 2023",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=MUTED, anchor="lm")
    y1 += 258

    # market bar chart
    d.text((C1, y1+36), "MARKET TRAJECTORY",
           font=fnt["MB"], fill=TEAL, anchor="lm")
    y1 += 92
    bars = [("2021",0.115,"$1.2B"), ("2022",0.275,"$2.9B"),
            ("2023",0.514,"$5.4B"), ("2030",1.0,  "$10.5B")]
    bmax  = 195
    btot  = col3w
    bw    = (btot - 3*40) // 4

        d.text((bx+bw//2, by_-30), lbl,
               font=fnt["MR"], fill=WHITE, anchor="mm")
    y1 += bmax + 115

    # applications
    sec_head(d, fnt, C1, y1+50, "02", "Applications", col3w, TEAL)
    y1 += 158
    apps_data = [

        ("Patient Communication",
         "Question answering, medical jargon simplification — early clinical deployment"),
        ("Medical Education",
         "Exam preparation, case-based tutoring — actively used by students globally"),
        ("Biomedical Research",
         "Literature synthesis, hypothesis generation, protocol drafting — emerging use"),
    ]
    for atitle, adesc in apps_data:

    y2 = BODY_Y
    sec_head(d, fnt, C2, y2+50, "03", "Performance", col3w, TEAL_LT)
    y2 += 158

    y2 = tw(d,
        "Performance on standardized medical examinations has become the "
        "primary benchmark for LLM capability in medicine — though real-world "
        "clinical performance remains less well characterized.",
        fnt["SeR"], C2, y2, BODY, col3w, 1.45) + 55

    d.text((C2, y2), "USMLE PERFORMANCE BY MODEL",
           font=fnt["MB"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    y2 += 68

    # passing threshold x position
    ptx = C2 + int(col3w * 0.595)

    models = [
        ("GPT-4",      0.95,  ">90%",  TEAL),
        ("Med-PaLM 2", 0.865, "86.5%", TEAL_DK),
        ("GPT-3.5",    0.60,  "~60%",  MUTED),
    ]
    row_h = 130
    for mi,(mn,fr,pct,mc) in enumerate(models):
        by_ = y2 + mi*row_h
        bl  = int(col3w*fr)
        d.text((C2, by_-28), mn, font=fnt["SS"], fill=WHITE, anchor="lm")
        rr(d, C2, by_, C2+bl, by_+78, 12, mc)
        d.text((C2+bl+22, by_+39), pct,
               font=fnt["MB"], fill=mc, anchor="lm")

    # threshold line
    th_top = y2 - 42
    th_bot = y2 + 3*row_h - 12
    d.line([(ptx, th_top),(ptx, th_bot)], fill=AMBER, width=6)
    rr(d, ptx-8, th_top-52, ptx+305, th_top-2, 8, AMBER)

    y2 += 3*row_h + 95

    rr(d, C2, y2, C2+col3w, y2+178, 20, CARD_BG, TEAL_DK, 5)
    d.text((C2+col3w//2, y2+66), "86.5%",

    d.text((C2+col3w//2, y2+136),

    y2 += 212

        fnt["SeS"], C2, y2+28, MUTED, col3w, 1.38) + 65

    sec_head(d, fnt, C2, y2+50, "04", "Risks & Ethics", col3w, AMBER)
    y2 += 158

    y2 = tw(d,

        (TEAL,    "04", "Equity Audits",
         "Assess differential performance across patient subpopulations before "
         "and after deployment. Correct disparities systematically."),
        (AMBER,   "05", "Regulatory Alignment",
         "Ensure compliance with evolving FDA, EMA, and WHO guidance on "
         "AI-based medical devices and clinical decision support tools."),
    ]
    for pcol, pnum, ptitle, pdesc in pillars:
        y3 = fw_card(d, fnt, C3, y3, C3+col3w, pnum, ptitle, pdesc, pcol)

    # consensus statement
    y3 += 42
    d.text((C3, y3), "EXPERT CONSENSUS",
           font=fnt["MB"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="lm")
    y3 += 60
    rr(d, C3, y3, C3+col3w, y3+330, 22, (7,18,40), TEAL, 7)
    y3c = y3 + 72
    y3c = tw(d,
        "\u201cLLMs hold transformative potential for medicine. "
        "Their deployment must be guided by evidence, equity, "
        "and robust governance to ensure patient safety.\u201d",
        fnt["SeR"], C3+48, y3c, WHITE, col3w-95, 1.50)
    d.text((C3+48, y3c+28), "\u2014 Moor et al., Nature Medicine 2023",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=MUTED, anchor="lm")

    # ── Subtle LLM watermark ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    wm   = Image.new("RGBA", (1600, 440), (0,0,0,0))
    wmd  = ImageDraw.Draw(wm)
    wmd.text((0, 220), "LLM",
             font=ImageFont.truetype(
                 os.path.join(FONT_DIR,"BigShoulders-Bold.ttf"), 400),
             fill=(255,255,255,12), anchor="lm")
    wm_r = wm.rotate(90, expand=True)
    base = img.convert("RGBA")
    base.paste(wm_r, (W - MAR//2 - 160, 1000), wm_r)
    img  = base.convert("RGB")
    d    = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    # ── Column dividers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    FTR_TOP = H - 210
    for dx in [C2 - GAP//2, C3 - GAP//2]:
        d.line([(dx, BODY_Y+10),(dx, FTR_TOP-10)], fill=GRAY_RULE, width=3)

    # ── Footer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    d.rectangle([0, FTR_TOP, W, H], fill=HDR_BG)
    hline(d, FTR_TOP, color=TEAL, width=7)
    hline(d, H-20, color=TEAL, width=18)
    d.text((MAR, FTR_TOP+75),
           "Moor, M. et al. Foundation Models for Generalist Medical AI.",
           font=fnt["SeS"], fill=MUTED, anchor="lm")
    d.text((MAR, FTR_TOP+142),
           "Nature Medicine 29, 1894\u20131904 (2023).  "
           "https://doi.org/10.1038/s41591-023-02448-8",
           font=fnt["MR"], fill=MUTED, anchor="lm")
    d.text((W-MAR, FTR_TOP+108),
           "Medical AI & Digital Health Conference 2024",
           font=fnt["SS"], fill=TEAL_LT, anchor="rm")

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    img.save(OUT_PATH, "PNG", dpi=(DPI,DPI), optimize=False)
    print(f"Saved \u2192 {OUT_PATH}  ({W}\u00d7{H} px)")

if __name__ == "__main__":
